display_name: 宽范围独立恢复器源域一致性
description: 冻结窄范围、宽范围及宽范围加物理损失三个独立模型，以固定 clean 伪类别比较源域识别器一致性；并非 TX 真实准确率。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

code.environment: N607 CPU, two threads, CUDA hidden; source-only fixed evaluation

data.version: 672 previously explored source pilot records, epoch19 paired IQ
data.representation: Source L_s/U_s received and clean IQ with stored frozen clean pseudo-class; no transmitter truth
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 672 fixed source pilot records disjoint from each of the three 32768-ID candidate fits

roles.L_s: source IQ only, transmitter truth not read
roles.U_s: source IQ only, transmitter truth hidden

data.validation_ref: Frozen reader and prior raw/DURA/clean decisions must agree on each record
data.leo_config_ref: fixed source epoch19 seven simulated views

permissions.claim_scope: Frozen clean pseudo-class agreement only; not TX accuracy, target evaluation or real satellite

checkpoint.initialization: Three fixed final20 direct checkpoints, frozen DURA v1 and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL only for source evaluation
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact source checkpoint provenance, 32768 fit IDs and 672 pilot disjoint; no F-assisted training or target reads
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen source-only recovery checkpoints with fixed reader for source evaluation only
checkpoint.selection_rule: No model choice or updates; predetermined three-candidate matrix

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only, two threads, CUDA hidden; preserve all existing jobs

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: source-only summary after all fixed predictions; no TX truth

rows.method: Frozen reader agreement: narrow versus wide direct models
rows.purpose: Compare fixed source models without using transmitter labels
rows.seed_notes: No stochastic model, augmentation, or selection; fixed source pilot and DURA.
rows.scenario: 672 fixed source pilot IDs x their preexisting views
rows.budget_ref: 3 fixed recovery models, 672 source records, CPU 2 threads, no training

notes: Three source-only trained direct candidates frozen at final20; F and DURA are used only in post-freeze source evaluation.
Clean pseudo-class agreement is not TX truth, accuracy, target performance or a blind test.
No model update, TX labels, U_s truth, V or target reads; no source or target result alters fixed seven-view tests.
Three focused tests and one independent P0/P1 review passed; source real-checkpoint no-query smoke is first step.
